title: 东风第一枝·咏春雪
title_en: Dong Feng Di Yi Zhi: Spring Snow
author: 史达祖

form.zh: 词，词牌《东风第一枝》，双调100字
form.en: ci to the tune Dong Feng Di Yi Zhi, 100 characters in two stanzas

readings.zh: 这里读 màn，同“漫”，意思是徒然、白白地。
readings.en: Here it is read màn, the same as the word for in vain.

readings.zh: “重帘”的“重”读 chóng，意思是一层又一层。
readings.en: In chong lian it is read chóng, meaning layer upon layer.

readings.zh: “未了”的“了”读 liǎo，意思是完、尽。
readings.en: In wei liao it is read liǎo, meaning to finish.

readings.zh: “著”同“着”，这里一般读轻声 zhe。一说读 zhuó。
readings.en: This character is the same as the particle zhe and is usually read with a light tone here. Some read it zhuó.

readings.zh: “重暖”的“重”读 chóng，意思是再一次。
readings.en: In chong nuan it is read chóng, meaning once again.

glosses.zh: 沁：渗进去。
glosses.en: qìn: to seep in.

glosses.zh: 兰心：兰花的花心。
glosses.en: lán xīn: the heart of an orchid flower.

glosses.zh: 黏：粘住。
glosses.en: nián: to stick to.

glosses.zh: 草甲：草芽外面包着的壳，刚冒出来的嫩草。
glosses.en: cǎo jiǎ: the shell around a new grass shoot, the first tips of grass.

glosses.zh: 障：挡住。
glosses.en: zhàng: to block.

glosses.zh: 新暖：刚来的春天暖意。
glosses.en: xīn nuǎn: the new warmth of spring.

glosses.zh: 谩凝碧瓦难留：雪白白地落在青绿色的瓦上，却留不住，很快就化了。
glosses.en: màn níng bì wǎ nán liú: the snow settles on the green roof tiles in vain, it cannot stay and soon melts.

glosses.zh: 信知：确实知道。
glosses.en: xìn zhī: to know for sure.

glosses.zh: 轻浅：轻微，不重。
glosses.en: qīng qiǎn: light, not much.

glosses.zh: 行天入镜：雪花在天上飘，落进像镜子一样的水面。
glosses.en: xíng tiān rù jìng: the snowflakes travel through the sky and fall into water as smooth as a mirror.

glosses.zh: 做弄：故意弄成，摆弄出来。
glosses.en: zuò nòng: to make on purpose, to show off.

glosses.zh: 轻松纤软：又轻又松，又细又软，都是说春雪的样子。
glosses.en: qīng sōng xiān ruǎn: light, loose, fine and soft, all describing spring snow.

glosses.zh: 料：料想，猜想。
glosses.en: liào: to guess.

glosses.zh: 故园：老家的园子。
glosses.en: gù yuán: the garden of one's old home.

glosses.zh: 重帘：一层层的帘子。
glosses.en: chóng lián: layers of curtains.

glosses.zh: 乍来双燕：刚刚飞回来的一对燕子。帘子不卷，燕子就飞不进屋。
glosses.en: zhà lái shuāng yàn: a pair of swallows that have just come back. With the curtains down, they cannot fly in.

glosses.zh: 柳回白眼：柳树刚长出的小嫩叶像眼睛，叫柳眼。雪落在上面，柳眼就变成白的了。这里还暗用了阮籍会翻白眼的故事。
glosses.en: liǔ huí bái yǎn: young willow leaves look like eyes. Snow on them turns the eyes white. It also plays on the story of Ruan Ji, who showed the whites of his eyes to people he disliked.

glosses.zh: 红欲断：红色的花快被盖没了。
glosses.en: hóng yù duàn: the red of the flowers is almost hidden.

glosses.zh: 杏开素面：杏花被雪盖住，像不搽胭脂的白净脸。
glosses.en: xìng kāi sù miàn: apricot blossoms covered in snow look like faces with no makeup.

glosses.zh: 山阴：今浙江绍兴。东晋王徽之在山阴住，雪夜忽然想念朋友戴逵，连夜坐船去看他，到了门口又回来了，说：“乘兴而来，兴尽而返。”
glosses.en: shān yīn: Shanyin, today's Shaoxing in Zhejiang. On a snowy night Wang Huizhi there suddenly missed his friend Dai Kui and took a boat all night to see him. At the door he turned back, saying he had come on a whim, and the whim was over.

glosses.zh: 厚盟遂妨上苑：相传西汉梁孝王在自己的园子里赏雪宴客，司马相如来晚了。这句是说雪阻碍了去园林赴约。上苑，帝王的园林。一说指好友的约会被雪耽误了。
glosses.en: hòu méng suì fáng shàng yuàn: legend says Prince Xiao of Liang held a snow feast in his garden, and Sima Xiangru arrived late. The line means the snow got in the way of a promised visit to the royal garden. Some read it as a promise between friends spoiled by snow.

glosses.zh: 寒炉重暖：冷下来的火炉又生起火来。
glosses.en: hán lú chóng nuǎn: the cold stove is lit again.

glosses.zh: 春衫针线：缝春天衣服的活儿。天又冷了，就不急着做了。
glosses.en: chūn shān zhēn xiàn: sewing spring clothes. With the cold back, there is no hurry.

glosses.zh: 凤靴：绣着凤凰的鞋子，指年轻女子。
glosses.en: fèng xuē: shoes embroidered with phoenixes, meaning young women.

glosses.zh: 挑菜：挖野菜。唐宋时农历二月初有挑菜节，女子到郊外挖野菜游玩。
glosses.en: tiāo cài: digging wild greens. In Tang and Song times there was a greens-picking festival early in the second lunar month, when women went out to the fields.

glosses.zh: 灞桥：长安城东灞水上的桥，古人在这里折柳送别。唐代有人说“诗思在灞桥风雪中驴子背上”，所以灞桥也和风雪、作诗连在一起。
glosses.en: bà qiáo: a bridge over the Ba River east of Chang'an, where people broke off willow twigs to say goodbye. A Tang man once said his poems came to him on a donkey in the wind and snow at Ba Bridge, so the bridge is tied to snow and poetry.

translation.zh: 春雪巧妙地渗进兰花的花心，
translation.en: The spring snow cleverly seeps into the hearts of the orchids,

translation.zh: 偷偷地粘在刚冒头的草芽上，
translation.en: and quietly sticks to the new grass shoots,

translation.zh: 好像想挡住东风带来的新暖。
translation.en: as if it wants to hold back the new warmth of the east wind.

translation.zh: 它白白地落在碧瓦上，却留不住，
translation.en: It settles on the green tiles in vain and cannot stay,

translation.zh: 看来傍晚的寒气确实已经很浅了。
translation.en: so the evening cold must truly be light now.

translation.zh: 雪花飘过天空，落进镜子般的水面，
translation.en: The flakes drift across the sky and fall into the mirror of the water,

translation.zh: 摆弄出又轻又松、又细又软的样子。
translation.en: showing off how light, loose, fine and soft they are.

translation.zh: 我猜老家的人一定没有卷起层层帘子，
translation.en: I guess that back home no one has rolled up the curtains,

translation.zh: 耽误了刚飞回来的那对燕子。
translation.en: and the pair of swallows just come back cannot get in.

translation.zh: 柳叶刚绿还没绿透，柳眼又被雪染白了；
translation.en: The willows are not yet fully green, and their leaf-eyes are turned white again.

translation.zh: 杏花的红色快被盖住，像露出了不施脂粉的白脸。
translation.en: The red of the apricot is almost gone; the blossoms show bare white faces.

translation.zh: 想起从前的游历，就像王徽之雪夜去山阴访友；
translation.en: I remember old journeys, like Wang Huizhi's snowy night trip from Shanyin.

translation.zh: 这场雪也妨碍了去园林赴约的盛会。
translation.en: This snow also spoils the promised gathering in the royal garden.

translation.zh: 冷了的火炉又重新生起火来，
translation.en: The cold stove is lit once more,

translation.zh: 缝春衣的针线活儿也可以放慢了。
translation.en: and the sewing of spring clothes can slow down.

translation.zh: 只怕那些穿着凤靴去挖野菜的姑娘回来时，
translation.en: I only fear that the girls in phoenix shoes, coming home from picking greens,

translation.zh: 万一在灞桥边碰上这场风雪。
translation.en: might meet this snow by Ba Bridge.

background.zh: 这是一首咏物词，题目是“咏春雪”，专门写春天下的雪。春雪下得晚，又轻又薄，落地就化。词人从兰花、草芽、碧瓦、柳树、杏花一路写下来，用了很多和雪有关的典故，比如王徽之雪夜访戴、梁园赏雪、灞桥风雪，却通篇不说一个“雪”字。写作年代不清楚。
background.en: This is a lyric about one thing: spring snow. Snow that comes in spring is late, light and thin, and melts as soon as it lands. The poet moves from orchids and grass shoots to green tiles, willows and apricot blossoms. He uses many old snow stories, such as Wang Huizhi's snowy night visit, the snow feast in the Liang garden, and the wind and snow at Ba Bridge, yet the word snow never appears in the lyric. We do not know when it was written.

author_note.zh: 史达祖，字邦卿，号梅溪，汴（今河南开封）人，南宋词人。他一生没有考中功名，做过权臣韩侂胄的文书。韩侂胄失败后，他受到牵连被处罚。他最擅长咏物词，写燕子、春雨、春雪都很细腻，名作还有《双双燕》。
author_note.en: Shi Dazu came from Bian, today's Kaifeng in Henan, and was a Southern Song poet. He never passed the state exams and worked as a clerk for the powerful minister Han Tuozhou. When Han fell, Shi was punished along with him. He was best at lyrics about objects, writing with fine detail about swallows, spring rain and spring snow. Another famous work is "A Pair of Swallows".

appreciation.zh: 这首词像在给春雪画像。春雪不像冬雪那样厚，它“巧”“偷”，悄悄钻进花心、粘上草芽，想挡住春暖，却在瓦上留不住。它飘过天空、落进水里，轻轻软软。词人还想到老家的燕子被帘子挡在外面，柳眼被染白，杏花像白脸。下阕又想起雪夜访友、梁园赏雪这些故事，写炉火重燃、春衣不急着缝。最后担心出门挖野菜的姑娘遇上风雪。全词不写“雪”字，处处都是雪，又处处是春天。
appreciation.en: This lyric paints a portrait of spring snow. It is not thick like winter snow. It is clever and sly: it slips into flower hearts and sticks to grass shoots, trying to block the spring warmth, yet it cannot stay on the roof tiles. It floats through the sky and falls into the water, light and soft. The poet also pictures the swallows at home shut out by curtains, the willow eyes turned white, the apricot blossoms like pale faces. The second stanza recalls old snow stories: a snowy night visit to a friend, a snow feast in a garden. The stove is lit again and the spring clothes can wait. At the end he worries that girls out picking greens will be caught in the snow. The word snow never appears, yet snow is everywhere, and so is spring.
